name: HiveMQ Cloud
tagline: Enterprise MQTT broker cloud with REST management for clusters, credentials, and traffic control
description: HiveMQ Cloud is a fully managed MQTT platform. Its REST API provides cluster-scoped management of MQTT credentials, permissions, roles, clients, and broker metrics; it does not document provisioning or listing Cloud clusters.

auth.details: API token authentication; exact header and self-serve details verified from official docs when available

pricing.free_tier_limits: No permanent free REST API tier. REST API access requires Starter, which has a 15-day trial without a credit card. The free Serverless broker allows 100 connections and 10 GB/month but excludes the REST API.

use_cases: list HiveMQ Cloud clusters for an account
create or rotate MQTT client credentials
inspect cluster connection details for device onboarding
manage MQTT access control for IoT fleets
